fluff.overview: Lyran infantry draw confidence from knowing their equipment is first-rate, even when assigned to garrison duty on worlds far from the front lines. Motorized platoons add light transport vehicles to standard infantry formations, giving them the speed to conduct rapid strikes, screening operations, and quick withdrawals that foot infantry cannot manage. Armed with assault rifles and infantry-portable short-range missile launchers, these platoons carry enough anti-armor punch to threaten light vehicles and BattleMechs at close range.
